title: The Candy Route
description: Four trick-or-treaters walk the same block four different ways, and only one of them can prove it found the shortest route.
long_description:
Visiting every house on a block once and ending up back home is the Traveling Salesperson Problem, and it is famously hard: with 12 houses there are already almost 20 million distinct routes, and every house you add multiplies that by another factor.

So four ghosts each take a different approach to the same block. Wander walks the houses in any old order. Nearest neighbor always hops to the closest house it hasn't visited yet, which is fast and lands about 25% over the best route. 2-opt takes that route and unties every crossing until none are left. Held–Karp solves the small pieces once, reuses them to build up the whole route, and comes out provably perfect — but its work doubles with every house, so above 15 houses it doesn't even start.

From your phone, add houses and watch the exact solver drop out, or slow the ghosts down to follow one route step by step.
